questions.question: C# nima uchun ishlatiladi?
options: Microsoft platformalari — .NET, Windows, Azure, Unity uchun universal dasturlash tili

questions.question: C# da o'zgaruvchi qanday e'lon qilinadi?
C# da Console.WriteLine() nima qiladi?
options: Konsolga matn chiqaradi va yangi qatorga o'tadi

questions.question: C# da class qanday e'lon qilinadi?
C# da interface qanday e'lon qilinadi?
C# da List<T> nima?
options: Generic dinamik ro'yxat — hajmi avtomatik kengayadi

questions.question: C# da namespace nima uchun?
options: Klasslar va tiplar uchun mantiqiy guruh — nom ziddiyatini oldini olish

questions.question: C# da try-catch-finally nima uchun?
options: Istisno (exception) larni boshqarish — finally har doim ishlaydi

questions.question: C# da override kalit so'zi nima?
options: Ota klassdan virtual/abstract metodini qayta implement qilish

questions.question: C# da properties nima?
options: Get/set accessor bilan maydon kabi ishlatiladigan, validatsiyaga imkon beruvchi qurilma

questions.question: C# da using statement nima uchun?
options: IDisposable resurslarni avtomatik yopish — fayl, DB ulanish

questions.question: C# da struct va class farqi?
options: struct — value type (stack); class — reference type (heap); struct meros olmaydi

questions.question: C# da abstract class nima?
options: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri instantiate bo'lmaydigan, abstract metodlari bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan klass

questions.question: C# da LINQ nima?
options: Language Integrated Query — kollektsiyalar va ma'lumotlarga SQL-like so'rovlar

questions.question: C# da async/await nima uchun?
options: Asinxron operatsiyalarni sinxron ko'rinishda yozish — UI ni bloklamas

questions.question: C# da delegate nima?
options: Funksiya tipini ifodalovchi tip — metod referencelari uchun

questions.question: C# da event nima?
options: Delegate asosida observer pattern — publisher/subscriber model

questions.question: C# da Generics nima?
options: Tip parametrlari bilan qayta ishlatiladigan klass va metodlar — List<T>, Dictionary<K,V>

questions.question: C# da Extension methods nima?
options: Mavjud tipga yangi metodlar qo'shish — this kalit so'zi bilan static metodda

questions.question: C# da Nullable types nima?
options: Value type ga null qiymatni ruxsat berish — int? yoki Nullable<int>

questions.question: C# da record nima (C# 9)?
options: Immutable ma'lumot tashuvchi — with expression, equality, ToString avtomatik

questions.question: C# da pattern matching nima?
options: switch expression, is operator bilan tip va qiymat tekshirish — is string s

questions.question: C# da IEnumerable va IQueryable farqi?
options: IEnumerable — xotirada; IQueryable — expression tree, deferred execution (DB uchun)

questions.question: C# da Task va Thread farqi nima?
options: Task — yengil, thread pool ishlatadi, async/await bilan; Thread — OS thread, og'irroq

questions.question: C# da Dependency Injection nima?
options: Ob'ekt bog'liqliklarini tashqaridan kiritish — .NET DI Container (IServiceCollection)

questions.question: C# da var kalit so'zi nima?
options: Tip inference — kompilyator tipni o'zi aniqlaydi (runtime dinamik emas)

questions.question: C# da init property accessor nima (C# 9)?
options: Faqat konstruktorda yoki ob'ekt initializer da belgilanishi mumkin — readonly kabi

questions.question: C# da IDisposable nima uchun?
options: Boshqarilmagan resurslarni bo'shatish uchun interfeys — Dispose() metodi

questions.question: C# da Span<T> nima uchun?
options: Stack da turuvchi, heap allocationsiz slicing — performance critical kod uchun

questions.question: C# da lock statement nima qiladi?
options: Ko'p thread muhitida shared resursga kirish uchun mutual exclusion — Monitor.Enter/Exit shorthand

questions.question: C# da sealed class nima?
options: Meros olinishi man qilingan klass — performance optimallashtirish ham beradi

questions.question: C# da readonly va const farqi?
options: readonly — runtime da bir marta belgilanadi; const — compile-time, static implicit

questions.question: C# da object initializer nima?
options: Ob'ekt yaratishda xususiyatlarni belgilash: new Person { Name='Ali', Age=25 }

questions.question: C# da Expression trees nima?
options: Kodni ma'lumot sifatida ifodalovchi daraxt — LINQ to SQL, ORM uchun dinamik so'rov yaratish

questions.question: C# da Memory<T> va Span<T> farqi?
options: Span<T> faqat stack (sync); Memory<T> heap da saqlanadi, async da ishlatish mumkin

questions.question: C# da Source Generators nima?
options: Kompilyatsiya vaqtida kod yaratuvchi Roslyn extensioni — boilerplate kamaytirish

questions.question: C# da ValueTask va Task farqi?
options: ValueTask — value type, allocation yo'q, ko'p marta await uchun emas; Task — reference, universal

questions.question: C# da IAsyncEnumerable<T> nima?
options: Asinxron stream — yield return bilan asinxron ketma-ket elementlar qaytarish — await foreach

questions.question: C# da Channels (System.Threading.Channels) nima?
options: Producer-consumer pattern — async ma'lumot oqimi, Channel.CreateUnbounded/Bounded

questions.question: C# da Roslyn SDK nima?
options: C# va VB.NET kompilyatorlar API — code analysis, refactoring, source generation

questions.question: C# da Natural types for lambda (C# 10) nima?
options: Lambda ifodaga compiler tomonidan Func/Action tipi belgilanishi — var inference

questions.question: C# da ref struct nima uchun?
options: Faqat stack da turadigan struct — managed pointer saqlash, async da ishlatilmaydi

questions.question: C# da Covariance va Contravariance nima?
options: Generic tipdagi meros munosabati — out (covariant), in (contravariant) parameter

questions.question: C# da global using (C# 10) nima?
options: global using namespace — barcha fayllarda avtomatik import

questions.question: C# da file-scoped namespace (C# 10) nima?
options: namespace MyNs; — butun fayl shu namespace da — inden kamaytiradi

questions.question: C# da required members (C# 11) nima?
options: required kalit so'zi — ob'ekt yaratishda belgilanishi majburiy xususiyat

questions.question: C# da primary constructor (C# 12) nima?
options: Klass deklaratsiyasida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri parametr — boilerplate kamaytiradi

questions.question: C# da Interceptors (C# 12 experimental) nima?
options: Source generator yordamida metod chaqiruvini boshqa metod bilan almashtirish
